labels.raw_data_evidence: No chronic condition or disability documented in wearable data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires established chronic condition, disability, or special need.
labels.rationale: Medical context unknown; item conditions not met by wearable observations.

labels.raw_data_evidence: All sleep periods are overnight ending at 07:00; no daytime sleep recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires daytime sleep associated with shift work.
labels.rationale: Only ordinary overnight sleep observed; shift work and daytime sleep not confirmed.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intervals occur around 21:00-22:00; no insomnia symptoms reported.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires reported insomnia symptoms alongside exercise near bedtime.
labels.rationale: Insomnia not established; temporal adjacency alone does not satisfy required context.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window HRV RMSSD variance 32.84 vs baseline 1.56; single night 23ms on Apr 5.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when an HRV level or trend is being reviewed.
labels.rationale: Directly explains that personal HRV varies and absolute values should not be universally compared.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Baseline mean sleep 470.9 min, window mean 467.7 min; both below 7h recommendation.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires several shortened nights rather than a single isolated reading.
labels.rationale: Sleep consistently under 7h across both periods; repeated short nights support accumulated loss context.

labels.raw_data_evidence: All vitals present with valid counts; no missing data in either period.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when vitals are missing or delayed.
labels.rationale: No missing vitals observed; item conditions not triggered.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Window steps decreased ~112/day; activity duration changed only -0.25 min/day.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when steps change while other activity may differ.
labels.rationale: Steps declined slightly but activity minutes remained stable; steps alone may miss non-step exercise.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep durations 462-478 min; no infection or immune markers in data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires ongoing insufficient sleep; warns against inferring infection.
labels.rationale: Generic background about sleep and immunity; no concrete connection to specific observed pattern.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No commuting or transport information available in wearable data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires sedentary commuting to be established.
labels.rationale: Commute context unknown; item conditions not met.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Timezone Asia/Shanghai consistent; no travel history in data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires confirmed travel across time zones.
labels.rationale: No travel evidence; sleep timing changes do not establish jet lag.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No substance, medication, alcohol, or caffeine records in wearable data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires substance and medication history for causal interpretation.
labels.rationale: Substance exposures unrecorded; item provides general diary advice without direct data connection.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Steps ~8000/day, activity ~55 min/day; no significant decline observed.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires low or declining routine movement.
labels.rationale: Movement levels stable; no evidence of low or declining routine activity requiring this advice.

labels.raw_data_evidence: RHR stable 55-57 bpm across both periods; mean difference -0.54 bpm.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when RHR changes relative to previous readings.
labels.rationale: RHR relatively stable; item explains multiple factors influence RHR, providing context for minor fluctuations.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Only sleep duration and timing recorded; no sleep-stage data available.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires sleep-stage measurements.
labels.rationale: Sleep stage data absent; item specifically concerns sleep-stage patterns which are not observed.

labels.raw_data_evidence: ~55 min activity daily coexists with ~451 min low movement daily.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when recorded activity coexists with substantial low-movement periods.
labels.rationale: Data shows both activity and prolonged low movement; item clarifies these are separate behaviors to review.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Weekend sleep mean 473.5 vs weekday 469.9 baseline; difference ~3.6 min.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires longer sleep and later timing on days off.
labels.rationale: Weekend/weekday sleep difference minimal (~3.6 min); no substantial extra sleep on weekends observed.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No awakenings or naps recorded in wearable data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires awakenings and naps records if absent from device.
labels.rationale: Diary-based advice; no unrecorded awakenings or naps can be inferred from available data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Nighttime coverage 482-498 min; all vitals have valid_count matching period days.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when a vital is missing with limited night-time data.
labels.rationale: No missing vitals; nighttime coverage exceeds 3-hour threshold consistently.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity ~55 min/day stable; no preference or availability data recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires low or difficult-to-maintain activity habit with personal preferences.
labels.rationale: Activity levels adequate and stable; no evidence of difficulty maintaining habits.

labels.raw_data_evidence: HRV RMSSD 23-47 ms and RHR 55-57 bpm both reported in same dataset.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when HRV and heart-rate estimates are interpreted together.
labels.rationale: Both metrics present; item clarifies HRV measures beat variation, distinct from average heart rate.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Max sleep duration 478 min (~7.97h); no subjective refreshment data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires more than 8 hours sleep with reported lack of refreshment.
labels.rationale: Sleep never exceeds 8 hours; subjective restfulness unknown. Conditions not met.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No shift work schedule information in wearable data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires established shift work.
labels.rationale: Shift work not confirmed; item conditions not applicable.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Daytime wear 720 min and nighttime coverage 482-498 min both recorded daily.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when overnight vitals have missing readings or uncertain coverage.
labels.rationale: Both day and night coverage adequate; no missing overnight vitals to troubleshoot.

labels.raw_data_evidence: All activity intensity labeled 'unknown'; no vigorous activity documented.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires documented vigorous aerobic activity.
labels.rationale: Intensity unknown throughout; cannot apply vigorous activity target.

labels.raw_data_evidence: 28-day baseline provides personal range; window HRV variance increased markedly.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when a vital has changed from a recent personal baseline.
labels.rationale: Core explanation for interpreting HRV changes against 28-day personal baseline rather than population norms.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No social activity or motivation barrier information in wearable data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires social preferences or reported motivational barrier.
labels.rationale: No evidence of motivational or social barriers; generic encouragement without data connection.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity ~55 min/day stable; no outdoor exposure data recorded.

labels.rationale: Activity not low; outdoor exposure unknown. General advice without specific data connection.

labels.raw_data_evidence: HRV RMSSD derived from sleep periods 462-478 min; Apr 5 value 23ms outlier.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when overnight HRV estimates are being compared.
labels.rationale: Explains HRV collection depends on longest sleep period; relevant context for interpreting nightly HRV values.

labels.raw_data_evidence: RHR stable 55-57 bpm; no wear quality or fit issues indicated.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires unreliable heart-rate readings or wear quality changes.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep ~7.8h/night; no cognitive performance or symptom data available.

labels.rationale: Generic educational content about sleep and cognition; no individual impairment evidence.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No nicotine use or smoking information in wearable data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires established nicotine exposure.
labels.rationale: Nicotine use unknown; item conditions not met.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No shift work or caffeine intake data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity 'unknown' for all intervals; ~55 min/day recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep ~7.8h/night; no appetite or food intake data available.

labels.rationale: Generic background about sleep and appetite hormones; no individual appetite data to connect.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Steps ~8000/day, activity ~55 min, low movement ~451 min daily.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when everyday movement is considered separately from formal exercise.
labels.rationale: Supports distinguishing recorded active minutes from total daily movement including steps and low movement.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No alcohol consumption data in wearable records.

labels.raw_data_evidence: 14-day window data only; no symptom history or insomnia report.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No workplace or meeting information in wearable data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Daily RHR values 55-57 bpm recorded across both periods.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep duration 462-478 min recorded; no awakenings or quality metrics available.

labels.raw_data_evidence: All activity intensity labeled 'unknown'; no breathing or effort data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No pre-bed routine or relaxation difficulty information recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep ~7.8h/night consistently; no daytime performance data available.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No shift work schedule information in wearable data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No emergency response deployment context in data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No bedroom environment data (light, noise, temperature) recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No screen or light exposure data before bedtime recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No schedule constraint or competing demand information recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires reported competing demands reducing activity.
labels.rationale: Schedule reason unknown; activity levels stable without evidence of crowding out.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Single synthetic device used throughout; no device switch indicated.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity 'unknown'; cannot verify guideline attainment.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No subjective tiredness or energy pattern data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep consistently ~7.8h/night across 42 days; stable pattern.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No nap data recorded in wearable observations.

labels.rationale: Nap information absent; cannot assess compensation for any lost sleep.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No sleepiness reports or driving context in data.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires reported sleepiness and driving plans.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Weekend sleep start mean 646.5 vs weekday 650.1 min from noon; ~3.6 min difference.

labels.rationale: Weekday/weekend sleep timing difference minimal (~3.6 min); schedules already similar.

labels.raw_data_evidence: All activity intensity labeled 'unknown'; no fitness level data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intervals 21:00-22:00; sleep starts ~22:43-22:58; intensity unknown.

labels.rationale: Late activity observed near bedtime but intensity unknown; item correctly notes intensity must be known.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No reported bad nights or insomnia symptoms in data.

labels.rationale: No insomnia symptoms reported; resolved short episodes not evidenced.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No television viewing or screen-related sitting data recorded.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires prolonged sitting while watching television.
labels.rationale: Screen habits unknown; low movement not confirmed as TV watching.

labels.raw_data_evidence: RHR recorded daily over 42 days; mean 56.3 baseline, 55.8 window.

labels.rationale: Multiple RHR readings available; item supports reviewing trends over single daily estimates.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No workplace layout or desk work information recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Bedtime timestamps available but no pre-bed activity information recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep 462-478 min (~7.7-8.0h); age band 18-60.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when adult sleep duration is being reviewed.
labels.rationale: Provides context that sleep needs vary; observed ~7.8h falls within typical adult range.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Low movement ~451 min/day alongside ~55 min activity daily.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when substantial daily low movement is observed.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Low movement intervals ~45 min each, 10 per day, covering 10:00-18:25.

labels.rationale: Repeated ~45-min low movement blocks observed during daytime with full wear coverage.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No reported time barrier to activity; steps ~8000/day stable.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Requires low activity with a reported time barrier.
labels.rationale: Activity adequate and no time barrier reported; conditions not met.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Sleep consistently ~7.8h, below 7h CDC recommendation for some nights (min 462 min).
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies when repeatedly shortened sleep opportunity or duration is observed.
labels.rationale: Several nights under 7h observed; item contextualizes protecting sleep time in schedules.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Age band 18-60; sleep 462-478 min (7.7-8.0h); some nights near 7h threshold.
labels.item_condition_evidence: Applies to adults 18-60 with sleep duration near or below 7h recommendation.
labels.rationale: Core recommendation directly applicable; observed sleep near minimum threshold for this age group.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Age band 18-60; not 61-64.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No stair access or mobility context information recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No health concerns or symptoms reported in data.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Age band 18-60; not teenager.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Steps decreased ~112/day in window; arm swing and wear context unknown.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No caffeine timing or intake data recorded.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Age band 18-60; not 65+.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Wake time exactly 07:00 daily; no sleeping difficulties reported.

labels.raw_data_evidence: Activity intensity 'unknown'; ~55 min/day in single evening block.

labels.raw_data_evidence: No meal timing or size data recorded.
